messages.en:
{07 00 00}I heard that you're wicked
at catching bugs!

But how good are you at{07 0b 00}
tellin' one bug from
another, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}I thought so! Why don't you
and me compete to see who
can catch the rarest bug?
{07 00 00}{07 11 00}I'm about to show you how
it's done!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kuulsin, et sa oled
putukapüügis kõva käsi!

Aga kui hea sa oled{07 0b 00}
ühe putuka teisest
eristamises, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Nii ma arvasingi! Miks me ei
võistle, kes püüab kõige
haruldasema putuka?
{07 00 00}{07 11 00}Ma näitan sulle kohe,
kuidas seda tehakse!

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Don't get a bloated head{01 00 00 05 00}
just 'cause you caught a
couple scrawny bugs!
{07 00 00}I think it's high time you
and me dueled to see who
can catch the rarer bug.
{07 11 00}Of course, I'll be the judge
of which bug is more 
rare{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}So,{01 00 00 05 00} are you in or what?
Eh, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Ära lase pead paisuma{01 00 00 05 00}
lihtsalt sellepärast, et
püüdsid paar kõhna putukat!
{07 00 00}Minu arust on ülim aeg, et
me duelli peaksime, kes
püüab haruldasema putuka.
{07 11 00}Muidugi otsustan mina, kumb
putukas on
haruldasem{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Noh,{01 00 00 05 00} oled sa nõus või?
Mis, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 15 00}Yo!{01 00 00 14 00} How about you and me
compete to see who can
catch the rarer bug?
{07 00 00}I get along with bugs
better than people. I know
them and understand them.
{07 15 00}So when you think you've
caught a bug that can't be
beat,{01 00 00 05 00} bring it to me!
I'll check it out and tell
you if it's something
special. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}So,{01 00 00 14 00} you game?
messages.et:
{07 15 00}Jou!{01 00 00 14 00} Kuidas oleks, kui me
võistleksime, kes püüab
haruldasema putuka?
{07 00 00}Ma saan putukatega paremini
läbi kui inimestega. Tunnen
ja mõistan neid.
{07 15 00}Nii et kui arvad, et
püüdsid võitmatu putuka,{01 00 00 05 00}
too see mulle!
Ma vaatan selle üle ja
ütlen, kas see on midagi
erilist. {01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}Noh,{01 00 00 14 00} oled mängus?
